Normal, everyday waking consciousness. Completely in phase with physical matter reality. Also referred to as “C1 Consciousness”.

sentenceCases.first: Focus 3 is a signpost on the way to Focus 10, a Hemi-Sync state where your brain and mind are more coherent, synchronized, and balanced.
sentenceCases.text: Focus 3 is a signpost on the way to Focus 10, a Hemi-Sync state where your brain and mind are more coherent, synchronized, and balanced. You will move to Focus 3 by a conventional count of one to three.

sentenceCases.first: The physical body is deeply relaxed while the mind remains conscious, awake and alert.
sentenceCases.text: The physical body is deeply relaxed while the mind remains conscious, awake and alert. “Mind awake, body asleep.” This is the first state of consciousness explored in our Gateway Voyage program.

sentenceCases.first: The Access Channel — the ultimate communication channel to all levels of awareness: mental, physical, and emotional.
sentenceCases.text: The Access Channel — the ultimate communication channel to all levels of awareness: mental, physical, and emotional. Opened during each Human Plus® exercise.

sentenceCases.first: A state of expanded awareness while the body remains deeply relaxed and asleep.
sentenceCases.text: A state of expanded awareness while the body remains deeply relaxed and asleep.
A state of No-Time. Consciousness is now far removed from physical body signals. Linear time is no longer relevant to experience. Sometimes referred to as the Void or Pure Potential.

sentenceCases.first: Through Focus 18, individuals can cultivate a state of unconditional love and acceptance, leading to profound personal growth.
sentenceCases.text: Through Focus 18, individuals can cultivate a state of unconditional love and acceptance, leading to profound personal growth.

sentenceCases.first: On the very edge of perception of the time/space continuum.
sentenceCases.text: On the very edge of perception of the time/space continuum. Mind remains fully conscious and active. The Bridge to other realities.

sentenceCases.first: On the border between time/space and non-physical states of being.
sentenceCases.text: On the border between time/space and non-physical states of being. Comatose.

sentenceCases.first: The condition in which an individual may find him or herself immediately following physical death.
sentenceCases.text: The condition in which an individual may find him or herself immediately following physical death. The territory of the ‘new arrivals’.

sentenceCases.first: The site of non-physical activity generated by simple or primitive religious or cultural beliefs.
sentenceCases.text: The site of non-physical activity generated by simple or primitive religious or cultural beliefs. One of the Belief System Territories (24–26): thought-responsive environments explored in the Lifeline and Exploration 27 programs.

sentenceCases.first: The expression of the major organized religious beliefs in recent human history.
sentenceCases.text: The expression of the major organized religious beliefs in recent human history. One of the Belief System Territories (24–26): thought-responsive environments explored in the Lifeline and Exploration 27 programs.

sentenceCases.first: Here are identified certain areas, few in number, containing the structures and knowledge of various highly individual religious and other beliefs based on direct experience of self.
sentenceCases.text: Here are identified certain areas, few in number, containing the structures and knowledge of various highly individual religious and other beliefs based on direct experience of self. One of the Belief System Territories (24–26).

sentenceCases.first: The edge of human thought capacity.
sentenceCases.text: The edge of human thought capacity. The site of a way-station (not a terminus) for rest and recovery from the trauma of physical death, for reviewing life events and for planning the next phase of life.
